existing_tips: Reported speech uses past perfect (hade fått) when the original was past tense (fick).
Past participle as adjective: changes for gender! En-word: -d. Ett-word: -t. Plural: -da.
Participles don't inflect: springande works with any gender/number.
"Så länge" = as long as. Second clause inverts after fronted subclause.
